subject: Cedarwood Analytics — vendor onboarding: PO intake & payment terms
messages:
From: Susan Keller <susan.keller@cedarwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Cedarwood Analytics

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Attached are our completed onboarding form and W-9 (cedarwood_vendor_onboard_form.xlsx; cedarwood_w9.pdf). A few things on our side to confirm for the PO and payment lane:

- Our standard terms are Net45.
- We do offer early-pay (Net10) for buyers who opt in; typical fee is 1.5% per invoice.
- We require PO header to include project code (CDE-*) to assist our reconciliation.

Can you confirm whether Redwood has any flexibility on Net45 vs Net30? Also — is there a preferred AP contact or a vendor portal link where we should register?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on another quick call if that helps.

Best,
Susan Keller
Head of Finance, Cedarwood Analytics
Susan.Keller@cedarwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Susan — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. Looping in Marissa (AP) and David (Finance) to confirm on the PO and early-pay routing.

Quick answers while they respond:
- We default vendors to Net45 for new suppliers, but there is an early-pay program we run for strategic partners.
- PO header mapping with your project code (CDE-*) should be OK, but Marissa will confirm how the PO field maps into our EDI/portal.
- Vendor portal registration link and next steps: Marissa will share the invite once intake is validated.

Marissa / David — can you review Cedarwood's ask below (Net45 default; early-pay Net10 @ 1.5%?) and advise if we can accommodate Net10 with 1.5% fee, or whether Finance requires a different fee structure? Also confirm the DocuSign we should send and whether we need additional tax forms.

Susan — I'll follow up after they confirm. If it's easier, we can draft a mutual action plan to get you live in the portal this week.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - Cedarwood Analytics

Jordan / David — thanks for the heads up and for the docs from Cedarwood. Quick notes from AP/Procurement side:

- Net45 is fine as our baseline for this supplier.
- For early-pay, our standard offer is Net10 with an early-pay fee that Finance sets based on volume/risk; typically that lands between 0.8%–1.25% for verified suppliers.
- 1.5% is a bit higher than our preferred ceiling; if Cedarwood needs that level we should route to Finance for approval.
- To enroll in early-pay we require: completed onboarding form, W-9, bank ACH verification, and signed early-pay Addendum via DocuSign.
- PO header mapping: we can include a free-text project code field (will be captured in our portal). Please confirm whether the CDE-* pattern is included on the requested PO examples — we'll validate mapping with our ops team.

I've attached the vendor intake checklist and a sample early-pay addendum for reference. If Cedarwood is willing to consider 1.0% (vs 1.5%), we can approve faster; otherwise I'll escalate to David for a one-off approval.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Susan — following up with the outcome from AP/Finance. We can proceed with the following onboarding/payment plan:

Summary (agreed next steps)
- Baseline term: Net45 (standard for new suppliers).
- Early-pay option: Net10 available as an opt-in program at 1.00% per invoice (Finance approved one-off reduction from standard band to support the engagement).
- Requirements to enable early-pay: signed Early-Pay Addendum (DocuSign link below), completed ACH verification, and vendor portal registration so we can map PO header to your CDE-* project code.
- PO behavior: POs will include a free-text Project Code field — please ensure your AP team reads that field for reconciliation.

Action items:
1) Susan — please review and sign the Early-Pay Addendum (DocuSign: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/abcdef123456).
2) Once signed, Marissa will send the vendor portal invite and an ACH verification form.
3) We will issue the first PO with the CDE- prefix once vendor portal is active.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake_checklist.pdf (intake checklist & next steps).

If any of that is a hard no on your side (e.g., you must have Net30), let me know and we can escalate, but from our side this is the fastest way to get you onboarded and eligible for early-pay.

Thanks again — excited to get Cedarwood live.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
